title: Clarified the public docs overview mission
points: The docs overview now frames psxGPT as a source-data system for knowledge workers, with PSX equities as the current public proof point.
The overview now states the product direction more plainly: reliable source data, CapIQ-quality structured surfaces, Excel-like modeling, and traceable validation.
The intro emphasizes that psxGPT is meant to remove slow retrieval and checking work so users can spend more time exercising judgment.
